name: ui-card
description: Bootstrap card: header (optionally a row with icon, heading and actions, foldable), body, footer, image caps, overlay, horizontal row, list group, theme colours, subtle, translucent; ui-card-group attaches cards.

descriptions.--bs-card-border-width: Border width (also the dividers between parts).
descriptions.--bs-card-border-color: Border colour without a theme colour.
descriptions.--bs-card-inner-border-radius: Radius of the parts at the edges (header, images, list).
descriptions.--bs-card-cap-padding-y: Vertical padding of header and footer.
descriptions.--bs-card-cap-padding-x: Horizontal padding of header and footer.
descriptions.--bs-card-cap-bg: Background of header and footer without a theme colour.
descriptions.--bs-card-cap-color: Text colour of header and footer.
descriptions.--bs-card-img-overlay-padding: Padding of the overlay on an image.
descriptions.--bs-card-group-margin: Space between the cards of a <ui-card-group> while stacked.
descriptions.--bs-card-body-gap: Space between the elements in the body.
descriptions.--ui-card-icon-color: Colour of the icon in front of the heading (icon attribute or slot).
descriptions.--ui-card-heading-gap: Space between icon, heading and actions in the header row.
